description: A fictional placeable spring bounce pad game prop, chunky low-poly, standing on the ground alone. A thin plate floating on four tall exposed coil springs, open air under it on every side. One square flat sand-grey painted top plate with wide chamfered edges and chamfered corners, about 0.05 m thick, with exactly nine big shallow square recesses with solid dark floors in a three by three grid on its top face and one fat raised chevron pointing to the front. Exactly four fat dark steel coil springs, one under each corner, about 0.20 m tall with exactly four thick coils each, each wound around a thick dark steel guide post. Exactly four fat dark steel cone feet, a thick octagonal collar with a short cone spike under it, one under each spring. One small teal lamp window in a thick charcoal bezel on the front edge of the top plate, in the middle. There is no base frame under the plate.
proportions: About 0.9 m long, 0.9 m wide and 0.3 m tall. (length : width : height = 1.00 : 1 : 0.33)
sides: the bounce pad is a square plate on four springs: four-fold symmetric apart from the raised chevron on the top face (pointing to the FRONT) and the small teal lamp window on the FRONT edge of the plate. Frame words: the FRONT is the edge with the lamp window; the REAR the opposite edge; the LEFT flank the edge seen on the image right of the concept.
